title: Policy Catalog Metadata
description: Required metadata block on every policy definition and initiative JSONC file. Every policy must cite at least one published framework — no bespoke policies in the catalog.

industry.description: Industries this policy applies to. Use ['all'] if universal.

frameworks.description: Compliance frameworks that cite this control. At least one required.

severity.description: Impact severity if this control is violated.

references.description: URLs or document IDs from the cited frameworks. At least one required.

effect.description: Default Azure Policy effect shipped in this definition.

remediable.description: True if a remediation task can automatically fix non-compliant resources.
